attempted_claim: Let k be algebraically closed of characteristic 0 and A the 3-dimensional Sklyanin algebra attached to a smooth Hesse-pencil member E with translation point of exact order 6 (the smallest torsion order >3 divisible by 3), with augmentation ideal m=(x,y,z), and let B=A (+) m*t (+) m^2*t^2 (+) ... be the noncommutative blow-up at m with center Z(B) and morphism proj Z(B)->spec Z(A). Prove or disprove by Groebner-basis normal forms for B plus central-section point-scheme analysis that: the exceptional central fiber over the origin has PI-degree 6, its singular stratum is the elliptic curve E with transverse type C x C^2/Z_6, and B localized at the smooth locus of that exceptional elliptic curve is Azumaya of the stated degree while the singular elliptic stratum is exactly the non-Azumaya locus of the fiber. A complete answer proves the fiber PI-degree, the transverse singularity type along the exceptional curve, and the Azumaya versus non-Azumaya dichotomy on it.
claim_type: fiber PI-degree plus transverse singularity plus Azumaya dichotomy
decisive_failure: Single-level Groebner normal forms and point-scheme data were tested only through bounded degrees (at most 6) on representative smooth Sklyanin parameters; the true exact-order-6 parameter presentation, the full Rees center, and complete-local/discriminant computations were not established, and the controlled literature-search tool errored so no external theorem could be imported. The freeness sketch against the transverse clause remains gap-mapped, not a disproof.
